PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: changes rotors' attach state from another thread while the game updates
PluginData.Description: Test only, for tests/mechanical-reattach-thread/rig.py of the Bugfixes plugin. A line "stream SECONDS" or "hammer SECONDS" written to reattach-probe.txt in the game's user data folder makes the probe spawn rotor grids and mark their rotors for reattach from another thread. It writes what it saw to reattach-probe-done.txt.
